milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate toward the emerald ore blocks at relative (4, 0, 4) and face them, confirming intentional observation. Max distance of 5 blocks requires the player to walk from spawn (~5.7 blocks diagonal away) toward the target. Facing tolerance of 60° ensures the player is looking at the ore.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted stone_pickaxe ends up in the player's inventory. The player starts without any pickaxe, and the only way to obtain one in this sealed room is to craft it at the provided crafting table using the given materials (3 cobblestone + 2 sticks). This is the most reliable and direct check for craft completion.

Uses inventory_has because when red_concrete_powder is mined, it drops itself as an item that enters the player's inventory. The player starts without any red_concrete_powder, and the only source in this sealed room is the single placed block at relative (5, 0, 6). Presence in inventory confirms successful mining.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The damaged anvil is at relative (-4, 0, 6), on the opposite side of the room from the emerald ore. The player must navigate across the room and face the anvil. Max distance of 5 blocks requires intentional approach (the anvil is ~7.2 blocks from spawn). Facing tolerance of 60° ensures the player is looking at it.
